# Operations Efficiency and Cash Flow Monitoring

This document details critical operational tasks and monitoring requirements for the bank, aligning with the 2026 strategy.

*   Monitor the branch efficiency standard update.
*   Investigate the cash flow urgently.
*   Update the teller performance for strategy 2026.
*   Optimize the customer wait time quarterly.
*   Investigate the teller performance for strategy 2026.
